label: Good-general favouring: depends on value at fixed end content, beyond present inputs
definition: GoodGeneral good fitOf Present φ: for some variation scenario s and candidates x, y, the favouring profile φ depends on the betterness standard good with the end-realization feature held fixed (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2, BecauseOfGoodness good fitOf φ s x y), and at least one of x, y is not a present input of the favouring at s. It is existential: one scenario and one pair suffice. The standard good is read as a VALUE ranking (x is a better good than y), not as an arbitrary scalar ordering; Lean does not type value, so this reading is a constraint on interpretations. Read so, the first clause excludes every favouring that does not depend on value at all (a nature determined to one end content, a physical law selecting by a magnitude that is not value), and the second excludes a comparator restricted to inputs present to it. At a source favouring before anything is produced, nothing is a present input, so the second clause holds automatically there.
note: Stipulative analyst notion (#2145 Investigation 4), attribution deferred. The value reading is load-bearing: with good := lower action and fixed endpoints as end-realization, a toy least-action law satisfies the formal definition (CriterionTable row 5, the semantic challenge's probe). It inherits from BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2 the need for a scenario that varies betterness while end-realization is fixed; on the control carrier the witness is cBetter against actual (goodness variation within one D-class), not the counterpossible valueless scenario. If betterness factors through end-realization, nothing is good-general (variationCore). See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section on joint coherence.
